#define GAIN 0.01
float helper(float x){ return x*GAIN; }
renderpass.name: Common

renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 o, in vec2 f){ vec4 prev = texture(iChannel0, f/iResolution.xy); o = prev + vec4(helper(1.0)); o.a = 1.0; }
renderpass.name: Buffer A

renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 o, in vec2 f){ o = textureLod(iChannel1, f/iResolution.xy, 0.0) * 2.0; }
renderpass.name: Buffer B
